name: Haunted town events
author: Alexandria
summary: An event pack for DownTime: ghostly random events for a haunted town. Turn it on with DownTime and they join the cellar, temple, tavern, work and rumour lists, and the general list.

_general.title: The bell at midnight
_general.text: The church bell rings thirteen times.
_general.success: You keep your nerve and sleep.

_general.title: A wrong reflection
_general.text: Your reflection blinks a moment after you do.
_general.success: A quick prayer and it behaves.

failure.text: You can't stop shaking all day.

_general.title: The lantern man
_general.text: A figure with a lantern waits at the crossroads.

success.text: You give him a coin and he points you the safe way.

failure.text: You follow him into the marsh.

_general.title: The whispering well
_general.success: You hear one you know (DM's choice).

pre-cellar.title: A walled-up door
pre-cellar.text: Fresh mortar on an old wall.

success.text: Behind it, an old shrine and an offering bowl.

pre-cellar.title: Crying in the dark
pre-cellar.text: A child is crying behind the barrels. There is no child.
pre-cellar.success: You finish the job with the lantern turned up.

failure.text: You flee the cellar. The job isn't done.

pre-cellar.title: Grave rats
pre-cellar.text: These rats have eyes like candle flames.

success.text: You drive them into the light and they burn away.

failure.text: They chase you up the stairs.

pre-pray.title: Empty pews
pre-pray.text: The congregation stares straight ahead and never blinks.

success.text: You break the spell with a blessing.

failure.text: You run before the sermon ends.

pre-pray.title: A bleeding candle
pre-pray.failure: It stains your hands for a week.

pre-carouse.title: A dead man's round
pre-carouse.text: A stranger buys drinks for the house. He was buried last week.

success.text: You toast him, and he leaves you his purse.

failure.text: You drink with him until dawn.

pre-work.title: The night shift
pre-work.text: The foreman asks who will stay after dark.

success.text: You stay, and the pay is double.

failure.text: You see something on the stairs and quit early.

pre-rumours.title: The missing
pre-rumours.text: Three people have gone missing this month.

success.text: You find what links them (DM's choice).

failure.text: Someone tells you to stop asking.
